items.title: Nike Is Reinventing Air for the Next 50 Years With Tuned Air
items.summary:
Summary 

Nike debuts Tuned Air, a digital printing process for custom cushioning.It removes rigid structures to create tailored, limitless underfoot sensations.The technology launches for runners in late 2027 before broader expansion.

Nike has introduced Tuned Air, a new way of making its Air cushioning units that the brand presents as the next chapter in nearly 50 years of Air innovation.

Instead of relying on traditional pins, rigid zones and the unit’s height to shape how Air behaves, Tuned Air uses a proprietary digital ink printed inside each unit, which Nike says took about a decade to develop. A selective lamination process then bonds the unit’s internal core only where no ink has been applied, letting Nike’s engineers control each unit’s internal structure with much greater precision.

The result opens up a far wider range of shapes, geometries and visual designs, giving Nike finer control over how Air looks, feels and performs. The name has precedent: “Tuned Air” was also the cushioning system behind the Air Max Plus, the 1998 runner better known as the TN, though Nike’s announcement presents the new technology on its own terms.

Following an exclusive sneak peek during Nike's World of Athletes showcase in this month, the innovative cushioning system is scheduled to make its official retail debut for runners in late 2027. This initial performance running launch will serve as the foundation for a much wider expansion, with the Tuned Air technology slated to be integrated across multiple athletic disciplines and the broader Nike Sportswear lineup. By removing…
items.t: Nike Is Reinventing Air for the Next 50 Years With Tuned Air

items.title: The Slim d’Hermès “Sous le charme d’Orphée” Brings the Myth of Orpheus to the Wrist
items.summary:
Summary 

Hermès adapts Alice Shirley’s Sous le charme d’Orphée scarf into a Slim d’Hermès dial.Engraving, miniature painting and pink opal cabochons depict a horse beneath a pomegranate tree.Only 12 white gold pieces will be made.

Hermès has unveiled an artistic addition to its minimalist dress watch family with the Slim d'Hermès Sous le charme d'Orphée limited edition. Drawing direct inspiration from the silk scarf of the same name designed by British artist Alice Shirley , the timepiece translates mythological storytelling onto a miniature nocturnal canvas.

Framed within the collection's signature slender 39.5mm white gold case, the dial depicts a horse galloping beneath a pomegranate tree under a shower of stars, which is a poetic nod to Orpheus, the legendary master of the lyre whose music enchanted the gods of the Underworld.
Bringing this fanciful scene to life requires an intricate convergence of traditional métiers d'art techniques executed across multiple stages. Set against a deep midnight blue enamel background, an engraver first sculpts the pomegranate tree across multiple levels to reveal the organic grain of the trunk and the delicate taper of its branches.

Several crafts come together on the dial. An engraver first carves the tree in layers, bringing out the grain of the trunk and the detail of each branch. A miniature painter then adds color one layer at a time, building up the leaves, the horse, the butterflies and the flowers. Finally, pink opal cabochons are set individually as the pomegranate fruits, adding depth and a soft shine to the scene. The…
items.t: The Slim d’Hermès “Sous le charme d’Orphée” Brings the Myth of Orpheus to the Wrist

items.title: Inside Denis Villeneuve’s Decision to Cast Robert Pattinson as James Bond
items.summary:
Summary 

Denis Villeneuve confirmed to ‘GQ’ that he chose Robert Pattinson as James Bond, in consultation with his producers and the studioHis list for the role starts with a believable killer and runs through charisma, sensuality, dark humor and physical strengthCasting took longer than fans expected because Villeneuve made the franchise wait until he wrapped ‘Dune: Part Three’

Denis Villeneuve has broken down exactly what he wanted when he cast Robert Pattinson as James Bond for the franchise’s 26th film. In his GQ Men of the Year interview , the director went through the role trait by trait, describing a 007 built less around gadgets and tailoring and more around menace, magnetism and nerve.

Villeneuve’s first requirement is that the audience has to buy Bond as someone capable of killing. “The first quality is that I need to believe that this man is a killer, because more than a spy, Bond is an assassin,” he told GQ . He also wants a visible rage behind the eyes, a quality he says only some actors have.

Presence comes next on his list, starting with a kind of panache that doesn’t apologize for itself. Villeneuve described a man who pulls the whole room toward him the moment he walks in, with charisma strong enough to carry a scene on its own. He also wants Bond to be openly sensual, someone people are drawn to and who visibly enjoys himself.

The rougher traits matter just as much to him. Villeneuve wants a Bond with a dark sense of humor, who seems to enjoy being in serious trouble and doesn’t mind getting his hands dirty. Physically, he called for someone strong…
items.t: Inside Denis Villeneuve’s Decision to Cast Robert Pattinson as James Bond

Netflix has unveiled the first teaser for 3 Body Problem Season 2, setting up the series’ return on January 14, 2027. The footage picks up with the San-Ti still headed for Earth and turns its focus to how people are living with a threat they can’t stop.

The new season moves on from the shock of first contact into a slower kind of dread, where the arrival is certain and the only question is how humanity responds. “We know there is a hostile alien civilization out there, the San-Ti, and they’re coming our way,” co-creator David Benioff said on Netflix Tudum. Co-creator Alexander Woo frames the season around whether the public has grown numb to the danger, and whether some people have started to welcome it.

That split runs through Tatiana Haas, played by Marlo Kelly, a true believer in the San-Ti who will go to extreme lengths to advance their agenda. Benioff explains that part of the aliens’ human support comes from people who believe humanity has failed to take care of the planet, which makes the coming invasion feel like a verdict to some of them.

Most of the Season 1 ensemble returns. Jovan Adepo is back as Saul Durand, Liam Cunningham as Thomas Wade, Eiza González as Auggie Salazar and Jess Hong as Jin Cheng. Benedict Wong returns…

items.title: The Bird’s Eye Chili Jumbo Wings From Earl Sweatshirt’s Camp Flog Gnaw Set Are Now on Bludso’s BBQ Menus
items.summary:
Summary 

Earl Sweatshirt and Bludso’s BBQ have teamed up on the Bird’s Eye Chili Jumbo Wings, a limited-edition peri-peri dishThe recipe brings South African-inspired spice to Bludso’s Texas-style smoked wingsThe wings debuted at Camp Flog Gnaw, where they were grilled live onstage during Earl’s set with MIKE

Earl Sweatshirt and Bludso’s BBQ have launched the Bird’s Eye Chili Jumbo Wings, a limited-edition collaboration that gives the Los Angeles barbecue spot’s smoked wings a peri-peri finish. The dish is a personal one for Sweatshirt, built around South African flavors linked to his own family history.

The wings start with Bludso’s jumbo wings, smoked Texas-style, and then get a peri-peri preparation built on bird’s eye chili. The small, fiery pepper is the traditional base of peri-peri, a chili sauce with roots in Southern Africa that’s now a staple across South African cooking. The combination keeps the smoke and bark of a Texas pit and adds a sharper, brighter heat on top.

The South African link runs through the artist’s family. He was born Thebe Neruda Kgositsile, the son of Keorapetse Kgositsile, the poet who served as South Africa’s National Poet Laureate. His father’s voice also turns up in his own music, sampled on “Playing Possum” from 2018’s Some Rap Songs, released the year the elder Kgositsile died. The dish was made to connect that history with barbecue, which makes it more personal than a typical artist menu item.

The wings had a fitting debut at Tyler, the Creator ’s Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival last weekend. During Earl’s set with MIKE , wings were…
items.t: The Bird’s Eye Chili Jumbo Wings From Earl Sweatshirt’s Camp Flog Gnaw Set Are Now on Bludso’s BBQ Menus

items.title: The Tesla Cybercab Is Officially Available to Buy Through an Early-Access Program in Texas and Florida
items.summary:
Summary 

Tesla launched an early-access program allowing select customers to purchase the autonomous Cybercab for personal useThe steering-wheel-free vehicle starts at $29,990 USD and requires an ongoing monthly autonomy subscriptionInitial vehicle deliveries begin in Austin this December, though nationwide operation hinges on broader regulatory approval

The Tesla Cybercab is officially entering the market, with the automaker announcing on X that select customers are being invited to purchase the vehicle through an exclusive early-access program. Designed as a fully autonomous two-door vehicle, the cutting-edge ride is built entirely without a steering wheel or pedals. Securing a spot in this initial rollout requires buyers to place a non-refundable $1,000 USD deposit, locking in a base starting purchase price of $29,990 USD. Initial vehicle deliveries for the early-release program are scheduled to begin in Austin, Texas, in December.

While the initial buy-in sits just under thirty grand, keeping the vehicle on the road requires an ongoing monthly autonomy subscription. Tesla includes the first month of this required software service within the base purchase price, but the subscription is currently set at $299  USDper month. However, that figure might see a rapid downward adjustment. Elon Musk took to X to state that the $299 USD monthly fee is too high, noting that the subscription should actually match the cost of Tesla's Full Self-Driving and connectivity packages for other models, which sits at approximately $115 USD per month.

For now, the Tesla Cybercab remains…
items.t: The Tesla Cybercab Is Officially Available to Buy Through an Early-Access Program in Texas and Florida

items.title: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto x texnh Pursue the “Ideal Black” in First-Ever Collaboration

At the center of the collaboration is a meticulously developed fabric called “DENSE BLACK.” To achieve the darkest shade, the duo carefully selected raw fabrics that suppress the whitening effect caused by salt-shrinking treatments, and successfully retained the dry, crinkled texture that washer nylon is known for. The brass hardware on the bags have also been completely covered in black, while the interiors are fitted with a khaki lining to provide a sharp visual contrast and make it easier to locate items inside.

Leading the collection is the Daypack. Built upon texnh’s signature “Flyer/Classic Daypack,” this updated model features a dedicated rear laptop compartment and newly added side pockets. items.title: Don Toliver Revs Up New Album ‘NITROUS’ for December
items.summary:
Summary 

Don Toliver recorded, produced and engineered his sixth studio album ‘NITROUS’ without any outside helpNew single “Party With The Boys” arrives with a Tyler Ross-directed music video featuring skateboarding icon Bam MargeraThe album caps a year that brought his first No. 1 album, five GRAMMY nominations and a 70-date sold-out world tour

Don Toliver has announced NITROUS , his sixth studio album, due December 4 via Cactus Jack/Donnway & Co/Atlantic Records. Don recorded, produced and engineered the entire project himself, so the record reaches listeners with no outside producer or engineer involved.

Making NITROUS entirely on his own marks a clear change in how Toliver builds a record , with every production and engineering decision now his. The first preview is “Party With The Boys,” out now with an official music video directed by Tyler Ross and starring Bam Margera. Casting the Jackass veteran pulls Toliver skate-video energy straight into the album rollout.

The announcement follows five nominations at the 69th Annual GRAMMY Awards, the most of any rapper this cycle. Toliver is up for Best New Artist and Best Rap Album for OCTANE . He also has nominations for Best Rap Performance for “Body,” and Best Melodic Rap Performance and Best Rap Song, both for “E85.”

NITROUS arrives less than a year after OCTANE , the fifth album that earned Toliver his first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and topped Spotify and Apple Music globally. Every one of its 18 tracks reached the Billboard Hot 100, and the album hasn’t left the Billboard 200 since it debuted. Its totals now…

items.title: Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine to Star in B.J. Novak and A24's Las Vegas Drama 'American Epic'

Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine are teaming up to star in a new drama series package titled American EpicThe project is being written by B.J. A24 is officially shopping a highly anticipated new drama series package titled American Epic , starring Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine . Written by The Office alumnus B.J. Novak , the project hails from Joe Hipps’ A24-based production company Cut To and marks the first on-screen pairing for the two acclaimed actors.

Set against the backdrop of Las Vegas, American Epic centers on a high-stakes ideological clash. In a final bid to forge his lasting legacy, magnetic casino mogul Wyatt Pascal (played by Cage) squares off with Midwestern pastor Bill Massey (played by Pine). Together, the two opposing forces attempt to pull off one last impossible act: building something eternal in the most temporary place on earth.

The project has already generated significant interest across the industry, with platforms like HBO and Amazon currently eyeing the series as a potential acquisition. Novak serves as an executive producer alongside Pine, Ian Gotler of Barry Linen Motion Pictures, Hipps, and Patrick McDonald of Cut To. The package serves as another major talent-driven endeavor for Hipps, who previously secured straight-to-series orders for A24 television projects featuring Gwyneth Paltrow, Nicole Kidman, and Joel Edgerton.

American Epic arrives during a busy creative season…
items.t: Nicolas Cage and Chris Pine to Star in B.J. Novak and A24's Las Vegas Drama 'American Epic'

items.title: Gentle Monster Premieres Intelligent Eyewear Campaign Film Starring Joaquin Phoenix
items.summary:
Summary 

Gentle Monster has released its full Intelligent Eyewear campaign film directed by Jonathan Glazer and starring Joaquin PhoenixThe cinematic visual takes an experimental approach to storytelling through tension, absurdity, and dark humorThe 16-piece collection is currently on display at a New York public preview ahead of its impending rollout

Gentle Monster has officially premiered the full campaign film for its Intelligent Eyewear Collection. Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Jonathan Glazer and starring Academy Award-winning actor Joaquin Phoenix , the unconventional visual challenges traditional wearable technology campaigns by blending tension, absurdity, and dark humor into a distinct cinematic experience.

Departing from standard product storytelling, the campaign places audiences in a heightened visual world where the unexpected becomes increasingly ordinary. Glazer’s uncompromising approach to filmmaking, defined by precise visual composition and an unconventional narrative structure, is seamlessly paired with Phoenix’s nuanced, deeply human performance. Drake has reportedly set a monumental new streaming benchmark on Spotify , reaching 18.9 billion streams across all credits in 2026. Setting a new single-year rap record before the calendar has even closed, the Toronto heavyweight has officially surpassed his previous high of 18.4 billion streams established in 2025, effectively claiming the top five streaming years in the genre's history.

The unprecedented surge in numbers began in May when Drake simultaneously released three highly anticipated solo albums— ICEMAN , MAID OF HONOUR , and HABIBTI . Arriving as his first solo efforts since his high-profile 2024 feud with Kendrick Lamar, the trio made Billboard 200 history by instantly claiming the top three spots on the chart. Propelled by massive early momentum, ICEMAN notably became the first hip-hop project of 2026 to surpass two billion Spotify plays, achieving the milestone in under three months.

A second wave of commercial dominance arrived in the autumn months with the release of FOMO , the deluxe edition of HABIBTI . The expanded project successfully pushed the album from No. 116 back to No. 2 on the Billboard 200 in October, moving 71,000 units in its first week. Bolstered by the enduring performance of his…

Shyamalan co-created Remain alongside Sparks, with the duo independently writing a screenplay and a novel based on the exact same concept and characters, tailored specifically to their respective mediums. Directed by Shyamalan, the film stars Jake Gyllenhaal as Tate Gordon, a grieving and reclusive architect who relocates to a small coastal town in Cape Cod after leaving a psychiatric facility. While trying to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman ( Phoebe Dynevor ) who pulls him out of his shell and directly into the center of a deadly mystery.

items.title: The 14 best men’s boots for winter, from chelseas and lace-ups to wellies
items.summary:
Whether you want minimalist or heritage, waterproof or suede, our menswear expert has rounded up the most stylish pairs for every occasion and outfit

• The best men’s coats for autumn and winter

I haven’t always worn boots. For years I wrote them off – at 5ft 8in, I was convinced anything above the ankle would make my legs look shorter. Then I started wearing them with the right trousers – a straight leg that falls over the top – and realised I’d spent a decade getting winter wrong. All anyone sees is a smart pair of shoes that happens to keep your ankles warm.

Here’s the thing: boots needn’t be intimidating. They’re just the wintry version of the leather shoes you already own. A chelsea is your loafer – it goes with pretty much everything in your wardrobe and every event in your diary, Christmas parties included. A derby boot is laced up, a bit sturdier and just as happy with jeans. The chukka is your weekend trainer. And the chunky, rubber-soled ones? Just think of them as an umbrella for your feet.
